tickets.subject: Critical alert missed overnight
tickets.body: A critical alert on our file server sat in the queue for 40 minutes on the night shift. It was below 60 low alerts from a scanner. Can the queue show critical first?

tickets.subject: Same alert 30 times
tickets.body: We get the same PowerShell alert from our CI runners dozens of times a day. Is there a way to group them? We can't turn them off, audit needs them.

tickets.subject: Phishing alert missing details
tickets.body: The phishing alert has no sender address or subject line. Please add them, we have to look everything up in the mail gateway.

tickets.subject: Why can't I isolate?
tickets.body: The isolate button is greyed out for me. Our lead was offline and we lost 25 minutes. Who can I ask?

tickets.subject: Export for board
tickets.body: Is there an export of the weekly posture I can put in a board deck?
